name: Night elf
summary: Night elves now defend their ancestral forests beside the Alliance. The kaldorei are an ancient, reclusive people of northern Kalimdor. Once rulers of a vast magical empire, they turned from arcane magic after the War of the Ancients and embraced Elune and druidism. In the Third War, they gave up immortality to stop the Burning Legion, then joined the Alliance as the Horde pressed into their lands.

sections.title: Children of the Stars
sections.body: Beside the Well of Eternity, the kaldorei began as a curious nocturnal tribe. Over generations, its raw arcane power changed them into tall, violet-skinned, long-lived people. They called themselves kaldorei, meaning “children of the stars.” Elune, the moon goddess, and Cenarius, the forest demigod, guided their early society and bound them to Kalimdor’s living wilds.

sections.title: The Empire and the Sundering
sections.body: Queen Azshara led the Highborne, the ruling caste, in pursuit of the Well’s endless arcane secrets. Their sorcery raised breathtaking wonders, but its reckless use drew the Burning Legion to Azeroth. The invasion ended in the Great Sundering. The Well imploded, breaking ancient Kalimdor into separate continents and destroying Azshara’s realm. The surviving kaldorei outlawed arcane magic, on pain of death or exile.

sections.title: The Long Vigil and the New Age
sections.body:
For ten thousand years, the night elves kept to themselves. Druids slept in the Emerald Dream to heal the world, while the Priestesses of Elune and Sentinels guarded Kalimdor’s forests beneath Nordrassil. Their seclusion ended when the Legion returned in the Third War and attacked Mount Hyjal. The kaldorei gave up immortality to defeat Archimonde.

High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Archdruid Fandral Staghelm now lead their people from their young World Tree, Teldrassil. The night elves fight beside the Alliance to protect Ashenvale.

faq.answer: In Darnassian, the night elves’ native language, kaldorei means “children of the stars.” The early night elves took that name after settling beside the Well of Eternity and devoting themselves to Elune.

faq.q: Where did the night elves originate?
aliases: where do night elves come from
faq.answer: The night elves began as a curious nocturnal tribe beside the Well of Eternity, long before the Sundering. Over generations, the Well’s raw magic changed their bodies and minds, making them the graceful, long-lived kaldorei.

faq.q: Why don't night elves practice arcane magic?
aliases: why did night elves ban magic
faq.answer: Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara and the Highborne drew the Burning Legion to Azeroth through their reckless use of the Well of Eternity. The war brought the Great Sundering and shattered the world. Afterward, the night elves outlawed arcane magic to keep demons from finding Azeroth again.

aliases: how long do night elves live
faq.answer: No. The Dragon Aspects blessed Nordrassil, the World Tree that gave the night elves immortality and agelessness. During the Third War’s Battle of Mount Hyjal, the kaldorei unleashed Nordrassil’s ancestral power to destroy Archimonde and lost their immortality.

faq.q: Where is the night elf capital located?
faq.answer: Darnassus, the night elf capital, rests in the vast canopy of Teldrassil. The colossal World Tree was planted off Kalimdor’s northwest coast after the Third War.

faq.q: Why did the night elves join the Alliance?
faq.answer: The kaldorei ended their long isolation to fight beside humans and dwarves against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. After the war, the Horde began heavily logging Ashenvale’s sacred forests for lumber. The night elves then formalized an alliance with the Eastern Kingdoms to defend their borders.

faq.q: Which classes can night elves be?
aliases: what classes can night elves be
faq.answer: Night elves train as warriors, hunters, rogues, priests and druids. They shun arcane magic, so they have no mages or warlocks.

angles.text: As a night elf, you carry ten millennia of wisdom and burdens. Your people face a perilous new age: mortality is real, ancestral forests are under siege, and old traditions are tested.
As a troll, you inherit a history that remembers the elves as ancient enemies, in a bitter rivalry lasting thousands of years.
As a member of the Horde, you face the kaldorei’s fierce Sentinels and watchful druids, made relentless and deadly adversaries by the Horde’s aggressive logging in Ashenvale.
As a druid, you follow a tradition shaped by Cenarius. Night elf guardians bind kaldorei druidism to the Emerald Dream and the defense of nature’s balance.
